singing_board.description: Interactive singing surface — touch points map to pitch and timbre, creating a spatial instrument where position becomes sound.
singing_board.name: Singing Board

vowel_instrument.description: Vowel space as musical instrument — navigate the formant plane to produce vowel sounds. Front/back, open/close become coordinates in phonemic space.
vowel_instrument.name: Vowel Instrument

vowel_synth.description: Real-time vowel synthesis from formant parameters — adjust F1 and F2 frequencies to morph between vowel sounds. Hear the geometry of the vowel triangle.
vowel_synth.name: Vowel Synthesizer

registry_info.description: Speech and phoneme artifacts — vowel synthesis, singing boards, and phonemic space exploration. Sound as computational material.
registry_info.name: speech
registry_info.theoretical_grounding: Phonetics, formant theory, vowel space geometry, sound synthesis, speech perception
